sh.line: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && { node .jig/checks/run.mjs --staged --ledger commit || exit 1; } # jig:checks
sh.note: One line for an existing sh pre-commit. Reads the index like the shim jig writes, because a commit carries the index and not the working tree. Skips silently when node is off PATH; the CI workflow is the floor.

node.note: One line for an existing node-shebang pre-commit (CommonJS). Reads the index like the shim jig writes. Uses the running node, so no PATH hazard.
